doc: Fill in, save as edits.json, then: python3 course_data/mapper/write_layers.py swope_memorial. See course_data/mapper/BRIEF.md for ops, shapes and rules. long_grass: a verdict per side on every hole, 'native: <edits>' or 'none: <what both years show>' (S2 silence is not a verdict). s2_suggested: Sentinel-2 native candidates (hint, not a layer): per hole and side set every candidate's decision to accept (its shape becomes add native with your confidence + evidence; the 10-yd keep-out applies), reject (evidence = why) or replace (you drew your own native edit in `edits`, e.g. the traced edge); undecided ones are listed in review.md.

uncertain.what: Imagery (NAIP 2020/2022) and lidar (2006) predate the recent restoration; the 2026 card is the post-restoration card. Fairway lines, bunkers, tree removals and new tees from the restoration are not visible; where they differ, the auto (OSM) layers were left unchanged.
Green tees of holes 1 and 6 are the same point (both on one OSM box behind the clubhouse); possibly a routing / numbering change from the restoration. Not changed (routing is automatic).
Green 533 tee is a lidar_pad dot between the Bronze box and the railway embankment (measured 527); no clear box in either year.
Green tee measured 4-6 yds short of the 2026 card (470/475, 370/375, 421/426, 409/413); no separate box visible behind, possibly a new restoration tee.
forward-set walkback tees (Black 1/6/17/18, Silver 10/17) have no visible box; kept.
crowns not in the 2006 lidar placed from the photo (+/-5 yds; years disagree on lean / shadow).
several 2006 lidar crowns (h2 left at 284/309, h18 centre-left at 310, h1 right at 263) appear gone in 2020/2022: not added.
